spanish: Y si no se impureció la mujer, y pura ella, y será absuelta, y será sembrada semilla.

findings.issue: Niphal 3fs has the woman as subject and masculine זָרַע as the cognate complement; «será sembrada semilla» makes semilla the subject of the passive.

notes: Protasis, verbless וּטְהֹרָה הִוא, and niphal וְנִקְּתָה match the tokens.
